nodes.label: ADR-005: Separate Admin Backend Service
nodes.rationale: Admin routes inside the user backend, or a user backend accepting an elevated role claim, both risk a JWT-role-check bug escalating a user token to admin. Chose a fully separate `apps/admin-backend` service with a distinct JWT secret (ADMIN_JWT_SECRET), distinct database (sawit_hub_admin_db), distinct Vercel domain (adminpanel.sawithub.com, robots-blocked), and distinct CORS origin — making cross-service token reuse structurally impossible rather than policy-enforced. Trade-off: two services to deploy/maintain; shared ENCRYPTION_KEY still required so admin can decrypt user PII for support; some middleware/logger/OTel code is intentionally duplicated rather than shared, to keep each service independently deployable.
